question_text:
Which sentence correctly transforms the direct speech into reported speech?

Direct speech: The auditor said, "I have reviewed the financial statements."

A. The auditor said that he has reviewed the financial statements.
B. The auditor said that he had reviewed the financial statements.
C. The auditor said that he reviewed the financial statements.
D. The auditor said that he will review the financial statements.

options.text: The auditor said that he has reviewed the financial statements.
The auditor said that he had reviewed the financial statements.
The auditor said that he reviewed the financial statements.
The auditor said that he will review the financial statements.
